summary: Tiziana Life Sciences Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the last patient has been dosed in its Phase 2a INFORM-MS trial of intranasal foralumab for non-active Secondary Progressive Multiple Sclerosis. The filing provides a clinical update with topline data expected late Q3/early Q4 2026 and plans to present at the ACTRIMS-ECTRIMS meeting in October 2026. No terms (stake, price, premium) are stated. There is no board recommendation, advisor, structural mechanics, or regulatory clock for a corporate transaction. This is a routine clinical trial progress report with no special-situation corporate action.
